title: Pain & Injury Recovery
summary: Assessment-led recovery for musculoskeletal pain — whether it's chronic, recurring, or from a specific incident. We find the root cause and build a targeted, progressive plan.
heroHeadline: Pain has a root cause. We find it with data, not guesswork.
whoItsFor: You're dealing with pain that won't go away — or keeps coming back. It might be knee pain during runs, a back that locks up after sitting, a shoulder that aches every morning, or recurring ankle trouble. You've tried rest, maybe physio elsewhere, but the pattern repeats. You're ready for an approach that actually looks at why.
approach: We start with a comprehensive technology-driven assessment. Using VALD Force Decks and Dynamo, we measure strength, symmetry, and movement quality — not just where it hurts. Your treatment plan is built from your numbers. Every progression is tracked against objective markers, so you know when you're actually getting better.
features: Full-body musculoskeletal assessment with objective strength and mobility testing
Technology-assisted diagnosis (VALD Force Decks, Dynamo, HealthFlex)
Personalised, data-driven recovery programme
Regular reassessment to track progress and refine the plan
Clinician-guided education on load management and self-management

title: Post-Surgery Rehabilitation
summary: Structured, phased rehabilitation after orthopaedic surgery. We use objective criteria — not just the calendar — to progress you through each stage of recovery.
heroHeadline: Your surgeon got you through the operation. We get you back to life.
whoItsFor: You've had surgery — ACL reconstruction, meniscus repair, shoulder stabilisation, joint replacement, spinal decompression, or another orthopaedic procedure. You want to recover fully, not just get by. You need a team that takes post-surgical rehab seriously, tracks your progress with data, and knows when to push and when to protect.
approach: We work from your surgical report and surgeon's protocol, then apply our objective assessment framework to track your recovery. We use VALD technology at each phase to measure strength symmetry, power, and movement quality — gatekeeping progression on criteria, not just time. We stay in communication with your surgical team where appropriate.
features: Pre-surgical conditioning (prehab) to optimise surgical outcomes
Stage-gated progression based on objective strength and symmetry criteria
VALD Force Decks and Dynamo for limb symmetry index testing
Surgeon-aligned protocols for ACL, meniscus, shoulder, and joint replacement
Return-to-sport or return-to-activity readiness testing

title: Sports Injury & Return to Sport
summary: Injury-to-sport rehabilitation for recreational and competitive athletes. We don't just fix the injury — we test your readiness to return and make you more resilient than before.
heroHeadline: Getting you back on the field is step one. Getting you there stronger is the goal.
whoItsFor: You've been injured playing sport — or you're a returning athlete trying to reclaim your level. You want more than 'wait and see'. You want objective criteria, a clear pathway, and a team that understands what being ready for sport actually means.

Progressive sport-specific loading and conditioning

Gait and movement analysis for running-based sports
Clear return-to-sport criteria communicated at the start
